content:
You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

The prototype of Audi's new sports car has car lovers raving. The steering system may still need a bit of tweaking, as the car jack-knifes at higher speeds, and surely you'll want to be speeding a lot with that beauty. But aside from that the car caters to pretty much every wish.
What argument components exists in sentence " The steering system may still need a bit of tweaking, as the car jack-knifes at higher speeds, and surely you'll want to be speeding a lot with that beauty" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.
<opp>The steering system may still need a bit of tweaking,</opp> <opp>as the car jack-knifes at higher speeds,</opp> <opp>and surely you'll want to be speeding a lot with that beauty</opp>
